description: Quality-first multi-model routing and review guardrails for Codex.

interface.longDescription: GPT-6 Astra or GPT-6.1 Sol leads. Luna Max handles settled low-risk work. GPT-6.1 Terra is optional for bounded visual, computer-use, writing and scoped code-fix tasks. Complex diagnosis, accounting and shared-state decisions stay with capable Sol or Lead. Sol defaults to High; Terra defaults to Medium. Astra XHigh provides independent read-only review. Judge fit from actual outcomes, including saved data and rendered results.
defaultPrompt: Route this task through the lowest-cost capable quality team.
Audit my current model routing configuration.
